mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies along the Military Ridge State Trail with an air quality index of 53. The moon is in its new phase, and tonight the International Space Station will be visible at 9:08 PM, rising in the west over Mount Horeb and traveling toward the northeast near Home Depot for four minutes. The overnight low will be 63 degrees with no rain expected.

Regarding city news, the Verona Police Department is currently accepting applications for its free nine-week Citizen Academy program, which runs from September 23 through November 18. Additionally, the city continues to provide ongoing engineering reports to the City Council as part of its contract with AECOM.

There is plenty happening in the area. Today you can catch live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, the Dane County Farmers' Market takes place at the Capitol, followed by music at Paddy Mac's. This Saturday, look out for the Ironman Wisconsin Loop Festival on Main Street, and keep an eye out for trivia nights starting next week.

On Wednesday, September 10, officers responded to a residential burglary on Hunter's Cove Way. A suspect was located and taken into custody after a firearm was recovered at the scene. The individual is being treated for injuries and will face charges including burglary and reckless endangering safety.
Today's flavor of the day is Raspberry Cheesecake. The restaurant is currently open until 10:30 PM tonight, so there is still plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
